This paper presents academic research on voice conversion using open-source neural audio codec technology (Kyutai Mimi codec, MIT license). All software tools used are publicly available open-source projects: Mimi codec (kyutai/mimi), kNN-VC (bshall/knn-vc), FreeVC (OlaWod/FreeVC), FAISS (facebookresearch/faiss). Training data consists of publicly available speech datasets: LibriTTS-R (CC BY 4.0) and VCTK (CC BY 4.0). The work does not reference any Kyndryl proprietary technology, customer data, confidential information, or internal tools. No Kyndryl trademarks, logos, or product names appear in the paper. The affiliation is listed as “Enterprise AI Center” without specific Kyndryl branding. Computational resources were provided by the Enterprise AI Center DGX cluster. The paper will be published under SPIE proceedings, indexed in EI Compendex and Scopus.
